finalEditorialRepairs: The Tianjin I2C opening now uses 折腾 STM32. Firmware, rather than the OLED, is the object of compile/flash. English and both preview pages match.
The Chinese sentence gate now distinguishes a device from an activity or skill when selecting a verb and object.

The Chime ADC note states that the battery supplies the divider through AO3401; it does not describe a battery passing through a transistor. The Thevenin derivation explicitly sets the ideal source to zero in the circuit model.
Endings were compared across the batch; the Flash conclusion describes recovery of a defined saved setting, without promising preservation of an unsaved live value.
truthReview: Project-specific claims were checked against current homepages, relevant family notes, approved briefs and selected source excerpts. Protected long-form Turing procedures remain unchanged.
Qt runtime and compiler compatibility explanations follow the official Qt and Microsoft documentation. Local QSettings role checks are not presented as remote authentication.

Juanyun existing notes confirm two Flash pages, sequence, CRC32, commit and a four-second delay. The expanded format, migration and power-cut matrix are a proposed study, not a claim of historical tests.

FOC source was inspected locally at d539c4a4f2f8c66ed6dfe3ce02c2dbd31a681847, including board_config.c and adc.c. Actual schematic images distinguish two phase-current amplifier channels from the separate bus-current path.
FOC worked angle examples use an explicit Park convention. The injected ADC timing example is labeled hypothetical. Reconstructing Ic as -Ia-Ib cannot independently validate the current sum.
Chime startup measurements refer to protected-pack output, not cell voltage. Startup-current and ADC-settling numbers are calculations from stated assumptions, not measured test results.

Chime ADC calculations include 15 kohm, 22 kohm, 1 kohm and 100 nF: Rth 9.918919 kohm, tau 0.991892 ms, 0.1 percent settling about 6.85175 ms. Gate pull-up consumption and capacitor recharge are distinguished from divider current.
sourceAccessLimit: The DW01A PDF did not open in the web reader; official indexed text supported only the general sense-voltage and delay explanation. No exact protection threshold was inferred or quoted.
voiceAndBilingual: pass for local review; Chinese was composed first and English adapted with equivalent reasoning and factual status. No inventory-style claim disclaimers or repeated retrospective closing template were introduced. Reader-prose patterns and verb-object matching were reviewed in both languages.
crossPage: Homepages retain project progression. Each new note investigates one bounded technical question. Necessary opening context is short. Old suspended notes and original Turing procedures remain intact pending user review; publication must reconcile replacements separately.
scope: Only local review packets, writing guidance and handoff records change. Production content, application source and public assets are unchanged. About remains on its separate parked branch.
